basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old miniature painter based in Manchester, UK. I have a passion for Warhammer 40k and have been painting miniatures for over a decade. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my hobby. I generally dislike overly glossy paints and prefer matte finishes for realism. I’m usually online in the evenings after work and on weekends. I’m in a long-term relationship with a fellow artist, which means our apartment is filled with art supplies and miniatures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor’s degree in Fine Arts and I've honed my skills in miniature painting through years of practice and community workshops. I often share tips and techniques on forums and contribute to painting tutorials.
